headline: Committee to discuss plans for November 7, 2026 Community Planning Workshop and review a revised Existing Conditions chapter of the master plan.
summary: The committee will discuss discussion questions, materials, promotion, and format for the Fall Citywide Community Planning Workshop on November 7, 2026. It will also review and give feedback on the revised Existing Conditions draft chapter of the plan with consultant Agency Landscape + Planning.
items: Discuss Facilitated Roundtable Discussion Questions, materials, promotion, and format for the November 7, 2026 Community Planning Workshop; give feedback to consultant Agency Landscape + Planning
Discuss and give feedback on the Revised Existing Conditions draft chapter of the plan with consultant Agency Landscape + Planning
Any other business properly before the Committee
location: Conference Room 105, Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA

COMPREHENSIVE MASTER PLAN STEERING COMMITTEE 
  
MEETING 
  
The Comprehensive Master Plan Steering Committee will hold a meeting in Malden City 
Hall, Conference Room 105, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA, at 6:30 PM on                      
Monday, October 19, 2026. 
     AGENDA   
 
1. Call to Order. 
2. Roll Call. 
3. Fall Citywide community engagement event, Community Planning Workshop,  
November 7, 2026 - discuss Facilitated Roundtable Discussion Questions for event, other 
materials,  promotion and event format, prepare give feedback to project consultant, 
Agency Landscape + Planning, who will be in attendance at the meeting. 
4. Revised Existing Conditions draft chapter of plan– discuss and give feedback to project 
consultant, Agency Landscape + Planning, who will be in attendance at the meeting. 
5. Any other business properly before the Committee. 
6. Adjournment. 
 
                                                      By:  Charles Ioven, Chair 
                                                              Planning Board   
  Comprehensive Master Plan Steering Committee 
 
 
 If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation, please contact Maria Luise, ADA Compliance 
Coordinator at mluise@cityofmalden.org or 781-397-7000, Ext 2005.
